headline.text: L3 ML1 glycol hose failed during startup, leaking into chocolate hopper — *no product affected*, hopper cleaned before production.

summary: One active contamination event caught at L3 before production: glycol leaked into ML1 hopper after hose disconnected; hopper emptied, cleaned, and line restarted six hours later. Two date-printing errors caught and corrected at startup. One warehouse oil leak and one dirty-tooling storage flag at L1.

food_safety.title: Glycol leak into ML1 chocolate hopper
food_safety.summary: Both ends of glycol cooling hose disconnected at 06:10, leaking glycol into depositor hopper; hopper emptied, disassembled, cleaned, and sanitized before production started — no product impacted.
food_safety.status: Resolved — hopper cleaned and reassembled, line restarted at 13:03; maintenance replaced faulty fitting and confirmed no further leaks.

quality.title: MF Matrix date printing illegible at startup
quality.summary: Printer produced illegible date at line start; line stopped immediately, printer cleaned, printing verified acceptable before resuming.
quality.status: Resolved — printer cleaned, date print quality verified in spec.

quality.title: ML1 date format printed incorrectly for Mexico market
quality.summary: Best-by date printed in MM/DD/YY format instead of DD/MM/YY required for Mexico; caught during pre-production checks, corrected before any product released.
quality.status: Resolved — date format corrected and verified before production start.

sanitation.title: Dirty Matrix cones stored in cabinet
sanitation.summary: Multiple Matrix cones found dirty inside gray storage cabinet; cones should be cleaned before storage to prevent cross-contamination risk.
sanitation.status: Open — teams reminded to clean cones before storage; follow-up with shift leads ongoing.

sanitation.title: Oil tote leaking in warehouse staging area
sanitation.summary: Ingredient oil tote placed in staging area actively leaking; tote suspected damaged from forklift strike underneath; containment cardboard placed, tote flagged for removal.
sanitation.status: Contained — cardboard placed under pallet, tote wrapped overnight to prevent further drips; warehouse to pull and inspect for damage.

opportunities.text: Review Matrix cone cleaning and storage SOP with S1 teams — based on dirty cones found stored in cabinet, suggesting cleanup step missed before return to storage.
Review warehouse oil-tote handling procedures — based on today's leaking tote suspected damaged by forklift, risking contamination of nearby ingredient staging.

Consider adding glycol hose connection inspection to ML1 startup checklist — based on today's hose disconnect event and Chad Stone noting 'a couple weeks of downtime over the past 3 years due to issues with this glycol area.'
